faq.q8: What is the 1% idea, and what are learning weeks?
faq.q8_a: Small gains add up. If you get 1% better each week, each week builds on the last: 1.01 multiplied by itself 52 times is about 1.68, so after a year you are roughly two-thirds better than when you started. A learning week is any week in which you did something on the Hub: ticked an episode, or took a Predict, a checkpoint or a recall. Your dashboard shows how many of the year's 52 weeks you have learned in, with the last 12 as dots. Only you see it.
